playstyle: Five agile gladiators of the Arenai, all but one relying on two-dice dodge saves and only three or four wounds each, so they survive by avoiding hits rather than absorbing them. Gryselle's critical Grievous strikes, Retaria's flying range-2 Stagger hammer and Kalexis's four-dice flurries give a varied, aggressive threat profile, and inspiring adds Move across the board. Lacking a warscroll of its own, it plays as an Order treasure-raider or a territorial defender, winning through fast, precise strikes and objective control.
